component.name: OpenBRC
component.summary: Open source reimplementation of Barbie Riding Club

description.p: OpenBRC is an open source engine that runs the 1998 adventure game Barbie Riding Club on modern Linux, Windows and macOS systems. It reproduces the original game's behaviour while adding support for any screen resolution, aspect ratio and refresh rate, with Vulkan or OpenGL rendering.

OpenBRC contains no game content. You need your own copy of the original Barbie Riding Club CD-ROM: point OpenBRC at the disc, a disc image (ISO/BIN/CUE) or an existing installation the first time it starts.
